title: Fortuna d'un gran tempo (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Fortuna d'un gran tempo. 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Contra), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos2712); encoded by Jesse Rodin.
